resources.string: Manual entries and user-provided evidence stay in review until their economic meaning and actual funding account are confirmed.
Enter an item manually, or explicitly share plain text or a PNG receipt screenshot to Bill. Provider-specific imports remain unavailable until redacted samples pass replay tests.
Bill stored the user-provided text or receipt image privately on this device, but it will not guess missing transaction facts.
Amount, type, and description require confirmation
The file is unverified; confirm amount, type, and description
Bill did not OCR this image; confirm amount, type, and description
Local OCR only suggests fields; confirm amount, type, counterparty, and transaction meaning
No verified provider parser inferred a transaction; confirm every field
This creates a draft, not a posted transaction. You will choose the real funding account on the next step.
The text was explicitly shared to Bill and stored only on this device. It is not a verified Alipay, WeChat Pay, or bank record, so confirm every field before continuing.
This same evidence has been shared before. Check existing drafts and posted transactions before continuing; Bill will not merge it automatically.
You selected this text file through Android’s document picker. Bill copied a bounded local evidence copy without retaining its URI or identifying a provider, so confirm every field before continuing.
Matching file evidence has already been captured. Check existing drafts and posted transactions before continuing; Bill will not merge it automatically.
You explicitly shared one PNG receipt screenshot to Bill. It stays only on this device; Bill does not OCR or infer it. Use the original receipt to confirm every field before continuing.
Matching receipt-image evidence has already been captured. Check existing drafts and posted transactions before continuing; Bill will not merge it automatically.

You triggered this screenshot from the Quick Settings tile and OCR ran entirely on-device. Suggestions can be wrong. Refunds, red packets, transfers, accounts, and funding methods are never decided automatically; verify every field.
Matching local OCR evidence was already captured. Check existing drafts and transactions first; Bill will not merge or post it automatically.
Bill stored a bounded notification envelope only on this device. No verified provider parser inferred a transaction, so confirm every field before creating a draft.
Matching notification evidence has already been captured. Check existing drafts and posted transactions before continuing; Bill will not merge it automatically.
It will leave the review queue. Bill keeps its local audit evidence, but there is no restore action yet.
Possible duplicate: matching evidence was captured before.
Positive amount, up to two decimal places. Currency conversion is not performed.
For example: lunch, salary, or supermarket.
Up to 200 characters. Do not enter account credentials.

Enter a description between 1 and 80 characters.

Choose the account that actually paid or received this amount.

Posts an expense and an equal reduction of the selected asset, or an equal increase in credit-card debt.
Posts income and an equal increase in the selected asset account.
Choose a funding account before posting.
